name: Red Feast
body:
Blood is the life for all vampires, but you find it particularly invigorating and devour it greedily when given the chance.

Prerequisites: Vampire.

Benefits: You deal 1d6 Constitution damage and gain 10 hit points or 10 temporary hit points from your blood drain special attack.

Normal: A vampire deals 1d4 Constitution damage and gains 5 hit points or 5 temporary hit points from their blood drain special attack.
